findings.title: versionMatch throws on a running version that is not plain X.Y.Z
findings.detail:
parts() throws `not a version` for a pre-release or dev build version (e.g. 0.19.0-rc.1). No caller exists yet in this slice, so nothing breaks now; slice 05 will call it with the running binary's version.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: In slice 05, decide how a dev or pre-release binary is compared (strip the suffix, or treat it as a match), and test it.
